entries.title: Governance Console: Explainability & Compliance Export
entries.description: Every card in the Governance Console is now clickable. System Risk, Semantic Memory, Policy Violations, Audit Trail, and Cooldown & Rate Limits each open a plain-English explanation of the real methodology behind them — Bayesian risk fusion (conjugate prior + Hamiltonian Monte Carlo + hierarchical shrinkage), doubly-robust causal counterfactual estimation, FAISS-based incident retrieval, and immutable, cryptographically-signable decision records. Compliance officers can now generate and download a real PDF audit report — governance decisions, policy violations, and certifications — directly from the console.

entries.title: v4.3.2 Axiom — Enterprise Control Plane
entries.description: The first named ARF AI release. Axiom introduces deterministic replay verification, active cost inference via Bayesian experimental design, a hardened gateway with defense-in-depth, and a fully enterprise-positioned Governance Console. All Dependabot alerts resolved across all repositories.

entries.title: Enterprise Repositioning & Governance Console
entries.description: The ARF AI public presence has been transformed into an enterprise‑grade control plane for autonomous AI. The landing page, navigation, and messaging now speak directly to CTOs, compliance officers, and AI infrastructure buyers. The live demo dashboard is rebranded as the Governance Console with clearer sandbox disclaimers and enterprise‑ready trust signals.

entries.title: Dynamic Risk Tracking with Augmented Gaussian Sum Filter (AGSF)
entries.description: Pilot customers can now enable continuous Bayesian risk tracking via the Augmented Gaussian Sum Filter. Operating in log‑odds space, the filter maintains a Gaussian mixture approximation of the posterior failure probability, updating with every decision. It resists covariance inflation and provides sharper risk estimates than the static conjugate prior—all while preserving deterministic replay via intent‑seeded RNG.

entries.title: Cost Inference Engine (Maximum Entropy IRL)
entries.description: The governance loop now learns operational cost parameters from human overrides using maximum entropy inverse reinforcement learning. With a Bayesian prior and MAP estimation, the engine continuously refines expected‑loss minimisation to better match your organisation’s risk appetite. Available after recording 10+ overrides.

entries.title: Offline RL Policy Fallback (CQL + Lyapunov Barrier)
entries.description: An optional offline RL policy can now override rule‑based decisions when confidence is high. Trained via Conservative Q‑Learning with a Lyapunov stability constraint, the policy minimises long‑term risk while respecting safety boundaries. This enables adaptive governance that improves with operational history—without online exploration.

entries.title: 🧠 The Engine Now Learns from Every Decision
entries.description: Closed‑loop feedback is live: after a decision is executed, its outcome updates the Bayesian risk model. Semantic memory also now influences risk scores—past successes make similar requests safer, past failures make them riskier—all within an auditable, bounded weight. Risk scores are now true failure probabilities, giving you a decision‑grade number every time.

entries.title: 📘 Public Specification Updated
entries.description: The governance specification now describes the closed‑loop feedback mechanism and memory‑based risk correction. New constants (memory weight cap, recalibration threshold) are publicly documented.

entries.title: Public specification v1.2.0 – Added Lyapunov stability and cryptographic integrity sections
Pilot: Expected loss minimisation now supports CVaR (Conditional Value at Risk)
Demo UI: Added mobile‑friendly Mermaid diagram fallback
🔬 Mathematical Foundation Hardened
entries.description: The entire test suite was transformed into an executable specification. Bayesian risk scoring, policy algebra, and predictive analytics are now continuously verified for correctness, determinism, and auditability. Trust is proven, not assumed.

entries.title: 📦 Canonical Governance Loop Released
entries.description: Complete decision pipeline: Intent → Risk Evaluation → Policy Analysis → Expected Loss Minimisation → HealingIntent. HealingIntent now carries 30+ fields for full explainability and audit readiness.

entries.title: 🧠 Semantic Memory Foundation
entries.description: Added incident storage, similarity search, and outcome tracking. The engine can now retrieve relevant past incidents to inform future decisions—the first step toward a memory‑aware governance system.

entries.title: 🚀 Initial Core Engine Release
entries.description: First release of the hybrid Bayesian risk engine, policy enforcement, and multi‑agent architecture. The foundation of deterministic, auditable AI governance.
